capabilities: start a spaced review schedule (1-120 days) for any note
review today's and overdue notes from a study dashboard
mark reviews done, postpone them, or undo completions
track progress, streaks and seven-day activity in study statistics
receive in-app and optional OS notifications for due reviews
extras: Review data is kept in plugin storage rather than note properties; translations are machine-assisted except Korean, which has had manual editorial review.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to schedule repeated reviews of notes without adding review properties to the notes themselves.
summary: Spaced-repetition scheduler that puts notes on Ebbinghaus-style review intervals and tracks due, overdue and completed reviews in a dashboard.
